Hello,

I saw your opening for a User Experience Designer on LinkedIn and want to help shape the membership onboarding and trial booking journeys for Style Supply.

Previously at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows to improve interface usability. With a background in computer science from my B.Tech, I bring strong dev handoff credibility and technical feasibility thinking to cross-functional product teams.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates how I structured a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, viewable at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Mumbai. Would you be open to a quick fifteen-minute call this week to discuss how I map complex user flows?

Ananya
